title: Verify Gateway Models
description: From the host, curl the gateway to verify it answers and knows its configured models.

steps.description: Verification step: curl to localhost:4000/models with Bearer authorization.
Checkpoint: expected answer is a JSON object with data array listing llama3 and qwen2.5-3b.

steps.question: What should curl -s http://localhost:4000/models return?
steps.answer: A JSON object whose data array lists the two configured model names, llama3 and qwen2.5-3b
